# Ordinary Boolean convergence: informed first-source study

This context and all first sources are saved before observation. The author is
informed by the current common type/ownership Reference, finite ordinary Boolean
IR and sized projection/lowering restrictions. Exact deployed model and sampling
settings are unrecorded. This is neither a blind model trial nor a new adopted
contract, implementation permission, Guardian judgment or issue completion.

Ten desired forms and two deliberate staging counterexamples use only canonical
Bit/Unit/Q types, 0/1 literals, existing not/and/xor, ordinary if and explicit
static declarations. Nine projects include a separate observe main() wrapper.
The library f may have open ordinary classical inputs: the closed wrapper gives
explicit values but does not establish a generic classical-entry execution API.
The largest quantum state uses two qubits. Dynamic if/measurement feedback and
ignored observation outcomes are deliberate broader executable obligations; this
study does not claim the next implementation unit already includes them.

Each source is a complete tiny project with schema2 edition2026. Existing source
archives and authoring records remain untouched. Wrong first sources or failed
checks must be retained; repairs require separately named files. The new session
records real command vectors, exit codes and raw stdout/stderr. No recorded
command is executed by the metadata checker.

Finite check uses JSON diagnostics. Sized check runs the explicit source map and
entry f through parsing, generic checking, specialization, lowering and native
checking if those stages succeed. Sized stdout/stderr does not share the finite
JSON diagnostic schema. No --basis option is used to invent ordinary classical
input assignment. Existing execute_pure/execute_instrument APIs take quantum
amplitudes and reference dimension; open classical inputs need their own actual
interface before later tests can execute them.

The baseline reuses the exact prior parameter-pattern MSRV CLI and existing
kernel identified in identity-before.json. This is not a newly built current
HEAD executable. Relevant current hashes and prior build hashes are compared
without copying source snapshots. No Cargo/Lean build, maximum-size check or
production edit is performed.

Independent expected truth tables, conditional X maps and retained measurements
are specified in projects.json before checking. Closed CLI distributions probe
only the wrappers; future reference-aware tests must compare branch operators
or unnormalized density matrices instead of inferring correctness from output
probabilities alone. Unit omission cannot erase its argument/body effects.
